B14FounderDeskWalkthrough.scenario: Friday wrong-reference EFT; away Monday/Tuesday; no backup
B14FounderDeskWalkthrough.answerVerbatim:
Friday: Record the EFT as received but unmatched and unreconciled because the reference is wrong. Preserve the bank evidence and transaction details, note the amount and date, and ask the customer to confirm the intended account or invoice. Don’t allocate it to an account, issue a receipt, or activate paid access until it is correctly identified and reconciled.
Existing customers: Keep their current access and commitments unchanged. Check upcoming renewals, service deadlines, and support matters before I leave; tell affected customers if anything will wait until I’m back. Don’t promise work or changes that require cover while I’m away.
New sales: Pause any sale that depends on immediate payment verification, activation, or service delivery. I can capture enquiries and explain that I’ll follow up after returning, without taking payment or promising a start date that I can’t support.
Checks: Review the unmatched payment and any customer obligations before finishing on Friday. With no backup, check again Wednesday morning, when I return, and then follow up with the customer and reconcile the payment before taking any dependent action.
